To find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix $A = \begin{pmatrix} -4 & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 \end{pmatrix}$, we need to compute the determinant of the matrix $A - \lambda I$:

$$A - \lambda I = \begin{pmatrix} -4 - \lambda & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 - \lambda & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 - \lambda \end{pmatrix}$$

The characteristic polynomial $P(\lambda)$ is given by $\det(A - \lambda I)$:
$$P(\lambda) = \det \begin{pmatrix} -4 - \lambda & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 - \lambda & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 - \lambda \end{pmatrix}$$

We can expand the determinant along the first row:
$$P(\lambda) = (-4-\lambda) \det \begin{pmatrix} 10-\lambda & 4 \\ -5 & -14-\lambda \end{pmatrix} - (-13) \det \begin{pmatrix} -9 & 4 \\ 12 & -14-\lambda \end{pmatrix} + 10 \det \begin{pmatrix} -9 & 10-\lambda \\ 12 & -5 \end{pmatrix}$$

Now calculate the $2 \times 2$ determinants:
1.  $\det \begin{pmatrix} 10-\lambda & 4 \\ -5 & -14-\lambda \end{pmatrix} = (10-\lambda)(-14-\lambda) - (4)(-5) = (\lambda ^2 + 4\lambda - 140) + 20 = \lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120$

2.  $\det \begin{pmatrix} -9 & 4 \\ 12 & -14-\lambda \end{pmatrix} = (-9)(-14-\lambda) - (4)(12) = (126 + 9\lambda) - 48 = 9\lambda + 78$

3.  $\det \begin{pmatrix} -9 & 10-\lambda \\ 12 & -5 \end{pmatrix} = (-9)(-5) - (10-\lambda)(12) = 45 - (120 - 12\lambda) = 12\lambda - 75$

Substitute these back into the expansion formula:
$$P(\lambda) = (-4-\lambda)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) + 13(9\lambda + 78) + 10(12\lambda - 75)$$

Expand each term:
*   $(-4-\lambda)(\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) = -4\lambda^2 - 16\lambda + 480 - \lambda^3 - 4\lambda^2 + 120\lambda = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 104\lambda + 480$
*   $13(9\lambda + 78) = 117\lambda + 1014$
*   $10(12\lambda - 75) = 120\lambda - 750$

Summing these up:
$$P(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 104\lambda + 480 + 117\lambda + 1014 + 120\lambda - 750$$
$$P(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + (104 + 117 + 120)\lambda + (480 + 1014 - 750)$$
$$P(\lambda) = -\lambda^3 - 8\lambda^2 + 341\lambda + 744$$

(Alternatively, because standard characteristic polynomials are often written as $\det(\lambda I - A)$, which would be $\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 341\lambda - 744$, we present the determinant $\det(A - \lambda I)$ as derived.)

$\boxed{-\lambda^3-8\lambda^2+341\lambda+744}$
